        r1 = max(r for r, c in cells)
        c0 = min(c for r, c in cells)
        c1 = max(c for r, c in cells)
        if r1-r0 < 2 or c1-c0 < 2:
            continue
        # A frame has a complete one-cell border of its own color and only
        # background or that color in its interior.
        border_ok = all(grid[r0][c] == color and grid[r1][c] == color
                        for c in range(c0, c1+1))
        border_ok = border_ok and all(grid[r][c0] == color and grid[r][c1] == color
